name: icu
notes: Added 2026-10-03 for Web Tranche 1: JavaScriptCore/WTF require ICU >= 70.1 with the data, uc and i18n components (Source/cmake/OptionsJSCOnly.cmake, find_package(ICU 70.1 REQUIRED COMPONENTS data i18n uc)). It is a CRT port so the 06-web SDK does not depend on a host ICU (which would differ per OS and break the package boundary).

78.3 is the newest non-prerelease release (2026-03-17); 79.1rc is a release candidate. The archive's SHA-256 matches the digest GitHub publishes for the asset and its SHA-512 matches the release's signed SHASUM512.txt entry.

build.sysroot_stage=02-cxx and build.env.CRT_CXX_HOSTED=1: ICU is C++ and ships programs (icupkg, genrb, ...) with a plain `int main`; see porting/recipes/gperf.json for why both are needed. ICU is built without tests, samples and extras; ICU's runtime data is the default embedded data library (libicudata).
build.env.CRT_CXX_ENABLE_RTTI=1: ICU uses dynamic_cast/typeid (normalizer2.cpp, rbbi.cpp), and tools/crt-c++ compiles with -fno-rtti unless a port opts in.
